tasks.title: Aumet login fails in supplier-sessions (401, stays on login page)
tasks.brief: supplier-sessions.yml run (2026-11-14T11:35Z) : pharmaoverseas session saved; aumet failed with safe diagnostics {httpStatus:401, stillOnLogin:true, apiAuthorizationObserved:false, credentialsRejected:false, verificationRequired:false}. So supplier-health still shows aumet missing_credential after FIX44 (#376). Find why the Aumet browser login in tools/sessions/push-sessions.cjs does not complete (selectors/flow changed? submit not clicked? wrong login URL? API token not captured?). Use existing aumet-discovery/aumet-js-probe workflows for evidence. Read-only: login + search probe only, never carts/orders/POs; never print secret values. If the credentials themselves are wrong, say so clearly in the PR body (credentialsRejected must be detected). Tests required. No deploy.
tasks.acceptance: supplier-sessions saves an aumet session and supplier-health reports aumet connected, or the PR states clearly that the AUMET credentials are rejected; read-only; tests pass.
